description: Oscillator, 3HP, aimed at drum synthesis — sine by default, other shapes on the menu

params.text: Drops the whole pitch range by seven octaves, so the module runs as an LFO
Where in the cycle the wave restarts when SYNC fires; shapes the transient. Knob attenuverts the CV

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob; the channels patched here set the oscillator's polyphony
Where in the cycle the wave restarts when SYNC fires; shapes the transient. Knob attenuverts the CV

outputs.text: The wave, a sine unless the menu picks another shape

menu: Waveform — the wave the module puts out: Sine, Triangle, Saw, Ramp, Square, 25% pulse or 10% pulse
FM mode — the FM input modulates Exponential or Linear, through zero
Linear frequency mode — the frequency follows the pitch voltage at a fixed number of hertz per volt rather than an octave per volt
Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, V/OCT input or FM input
DC offset correction — on by default, removes the offset the square and pulse waves carry away from a 50% width; turn it off to use such an output as a CV
